title: Amazon's Zoox Wins First US Approval For Paid Robotaxis Without Human Controls - Slashdot

content_html:
An anonymous reader quotes a report from Reuters: Amazon's Zoox unit has won U.S. approval for limited commercial deployment of its novel steering-wheel-free robotaxis, a first for the autonomous ride industry, the U.S. auto safety agency said on Thursday. Zoox said that the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration's decision gives the company federal approval to begin charging for rides, and that it will soon begin charging for service, first in Las Vegas, with additional markets to follow as it completes various state requirements.

[...] NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison told Reuters that Zoox had received clearance to commercially deploy up to 2,500 vehicles in each of the next two years. Zoox currently carries passengers in parts of Las Vegas and San Francisco as part of testing. The exemption would allow Zoox to charge them fees, subject to state and local approvals. The agency said it determined the vehicle is as safe as an equivalent vehicle meeting federal motor vehicle safety standards that are being waived. Zoox cannot sell any of the vehicles to the public.

"We can say pretty clearly that the systems in place on the Zoox exceed the equivalent performance requirements of a compliant vehicle," Morrison said in an interview. "But we still want to make sure that the automated driving system will operate appropriately." As part of the exemption, NHTSA is placing additional reporting requirements on Zoox for issues such as crashes or stopping inappropriately on roads, and the regulatory agency will adjust the conditions based on how the vehicles behave. "We have the ability to pull the exemption if we see major safety issues," Morrison said.

All remote operators must be located in the United States, NHTSA said, and Zoox must publish maps of areas indicating where the vehicles are operating. Morrison said NHTSA expects to develop the first federal safety standards for automated driving systems by the end of the Trump administration. It is also proposing to overhaul some existing rules written with human drivers in mind such as requiring brake pedals and rear-view mirrors.

sentences.en: NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison told Reuters that Zoox had received clearance to commercially deploy up to 2,500 vehicles in each of the next two years.
sentences.zh: NHTSA 局长乔纳森·莫里森 (Jonathan Morrison) 告诉路透社，Zoox 已获准在未来两年内每年商业部署多达 2,500 辆车辆。

sentences.en: Zoox currently carries passengers in parts of Las Vegas and San Francisco as part of testing.

sentences.zh: 这项豁免将允许 Zoox 向他们收取费用，但须经州和地方批准。

sentences.zh: 莫里森在接受采访时表示：“我们可以非常清楚地说，Zoox 上安装的系统超出了合规车辆的同等性能要求。”

sentences.en: "But we still want to make sure that the automated driving system will operate appropriately."
sentences.zh: “但我们仍然希望确保自动驾驶系统能够正常运行。”

sentences.en: As part of the exemption, NHTSA is placing additional reporting requirements on Zoox for issues such as crashes or stopping inappropriately on roads, and the regulatory agency will adjust the conditions based on how the vehicles behave.
sentences.zh: 作为豁免的一部分，NHTSA 对 Zoox 提出了额外的报告要求，要求其报告道路上碰撞或不当停车等问题，监管机构将根据车辆的行为情况调整条件。

sentences.en: "We have the ability to pull the exemption if we see major safety issues," Morrison said.
sentences.zh: 莫里森说：“如果我们发现重大安全问题，我们有能力取消豁免。”

sentences.en: All remote operators must be located in the United States, NHTSA said, and Zoox must publish maps of areas indicating where the vehicles are operating.
sentences.zh: NHTSA 表示，所有远程操作员必须位于美国境内，Zoox 必须发布标明车辆运行地点的区域地图。

sentences.en: Morrison said NHTSA expects to develop the first federal safety standards for automated driving systems by the end of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 莫里森表示，国家公路交通安全管理局预计将在特朗普政府任期结束前制定第一个自动驾驶系统联邦安全标准。

sentences.en: It is also proposing to overhaul some existing rules written with human drivers in mind such as requiring brake pedals and rear-view mirrors.
sentences.zh: 它还提议彻底修改一些考虑到人类驾驶员的现有规则，例如要求制动踏板和后视镜。

content_html_zh: 一位匿名读者援引路透社的报道称：美国汽车安全机构周四表示，亚马逊旗下的 Zoox 部门已获得美国批准，对其新型无方向盘机器人出租车进行有限商业部署，这在自动驾驶行业尚属首次。 Zoox 表示，美国国家公路交通安全管理局的决定使该公司获得联邦批准，可以开始对乘车服务收费，并且很快将首先在拉斯维加斯开始收费服务，在完成各种州要求后，将在其他市场跟进。 [...] NHTSA 局长乔纳森·莫里森 (Jonathan Morrison) 告诉路透社，Zoox 已获准在未来两年内每年商业部署多达 2,500 辆车辆。 作为测试的一部分，Zoox 目前在拉斯维加斯和旧金山的部分地区载客。 这项豁免将允许 Zoox 向他们收取费用，但须经州和地方批准。 该机构表示，它确定该车辆与符合正在豁免的联邦机动车辆安全标准的同等车辆一样安全。 Zoox 不能向公众出售任何车辆。 莫里森在接受采访时表示：“我们可以非常清楚地说，Zoox 上安装的系统超出了合规车辆的同等性能要求。” “但我们仍然希望确保自动驾驶系统能够正常运行。” 作为豁免的一部分，NHTSA 对 Zoox 提出了额外的报告要求，要求其报告道路上碰撞或不当停车等问题，监管机构将根据车辆的行为情况调整条件。 莫里森说：“如果我们发现重大安全问题，我们有能力取消豁免。” NHTSA 表示，所有远程操作员必须位于美国境内，Zoox 必须发布标明车辆运行地点的区域地图。 莫里森表示，国家公路交通安全管理局预计将在特朗普政府任期结束前制定第一个自动驾驶系统联邦安全标准。 它还提议彻底修改一些考虑到人类驾驶员的现有规则，例如要求制动踏板和后视镜。
